mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, w.id AS warehouse_id, w.warehouse_code, w.warehouse_name, l.id AS location_id, l.location_code, i.batch_no, i.container_code, i.quantity, i.locked_qty, (i.quantity - i.locked_qty) AS available_qty, i.first_inbound_time FROM wms_inventory i JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = i.location_id AND l.deleted_at = 0 JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = l.warehouse_id AND w.deleted_at = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.batch_no = #{batchNo} AND i.ownership_type = 'OWNED' ORDER BY i.first_inbound_time ASC, l.location_code ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT o.create_time AS event_time, 'INBOUND' AS event_type, o.order_no AS bill_no, d.material_code, d.material_name, l.location_code, NULL AS container_code, COALESCE(d.actual_quantity, d.quantity) AS qty, COALESCE(NULLIF(o.consignor_name, ''), o.supplier_name) AS counterparty, o.create_by AS operator, NULL AS remark FROM wms_inbound_detail d JOIN wms_inbound_order o ON o.id = d.inbound_id AND o.deleted_at = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = d.location_id AND l.deleted_at = 0 WHERE d.batch_no = #{batchNo} AND d.deleted_at = 0 UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(p.complete_time, p.create_time) AS event_time, 'PROD_INBOUND' AS event_type, p.inbound_no AS bill_no, p.material_code, p.material_name, l.location_code, p.carrier_code AS container_code, p.good_qty AS qty, p.work_order_no AS counterparty, p.operator AS operator, p.manual_remark AS remark FROM wms_production_inbound p LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = p.location_id AND l.deleted_at = 0 WHERE p.batch_no = #{batchNo} AND p.deleted_at = 0 UNION ALL SELECT o.create_time AS event_time, 'OUTBOUND' AS event_type, o.outbound_no AS bill_no, d.material_code, d.material_name, NULL AS location_code, NULL AS container_code, -d.actual_qty AS qty, o.customer_name AS counterparty, o.operator AS operator, o.remark AS remark FROM wms_outbound_detail d JOIN wms_outbound_order o ON o.id = d.outbound_id AND o.deleted_at = 0 WHERE d.batch_no = #{batchNo} AND d.deleted_at = 0 AND d.actual_qty IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT o.create_time AS event_time, 'TRANSFER' AS event_type, o.transfer_no AS bill_no, d.material_code, d.material_name, d.out_location_code AS location_code, d.container_code, -d.actual_qty AS qty, CONCAT('→ ', COALESCE(d.in_location_code, '')) AS counterparty, o.operator AS operator, d.remark AS remark FROM wms_transfer_detail d JOIN wms_transfer_order o ON o.id = d.transfer_id AND o.deleted_at = 0 WHERE d.batch_no = #{batchNo} AND d.deleted_at = 0 AND d.actual_qty IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT o.create_time AS event_time, 'TRANSFER' AS event_type, o.transfer_no AS bill_no, d.material_code, d.material_name, d.in_location_code AS location_code, d.container_code, d.actual_qty AS qty, CONCAT('← ', COALESCE(d.out_location_code, '')) AS counterparty, o.operator AS operator, d.remark AS remark FROM wms_transfer_detail d JOIN wms_transfer_order o ON o.id = d.transfer_id AND o.deleted_at = 0 WHERE d.batch_no = #{batchNo} AND d.deleted_at = 0 AND d.actual_qty IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(o.adjust_time, o.create_time) AS event_time, 'STOCKTAKE' AS event_type, o.stocktake_no AS bill_no, d.material_code, m.material_name, d.location_code, d.container_code, d.diff_qty AS qty, d.diff_reason AS counterparty, o.initiator AS operator, d.diff_reason AS remark FROM wms_stocktake_detail d JOIN wms_stocktake_order o ON o.id = d.stocktake_id AND o.deleted_at = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = d.material_id WHERE d.batch_no = #{batchNo} AND d.deleted_at = 0 AND d.diff_qty IS NOT NULL AND d.diff_qty <> 0 ) t ORDER BY t.event_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
